voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Belen, New Mexico. September twentieth, nineteen eighty-eight. Nineteen-year-old Tara Calico left home at nine-thirty for a bike ride on Highway forty-seven.
She asked her mother to pick her up if she wasn't home by noon.
Witnesses saw an older pickup truck following close behind her. No one saw what happened next. Neither Tara nor her bicycle was ever found.
In nineteen eighty-nine, a Polaroid found in Florida was thought by some to show her. Its identification was never confirmed.
In twenty twenty-three, the sheriff sent the case to prosecutors. No one has ever been charged.
